id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_040.pack|cs_: "Wow! What are the feather people doing? They look like fun!
"Oh my! We're off to beat up a naughty monster and save the kidnapped villagers.
"So you weren't kidnapped... Why are you in such a dangerous place? Your father is worried.
"Dad told the monster that his most precious thing was Mum's necklace.
"So I wasn't his most precious thing. That made me so sad...
"So I'll get Mum's necklace back and show Dad! I chased the monster here!
"But I got scared on the way, so I've been hiding here...
"I see, Da said that. But this area is too dangerous for a child. Leave it to us and go home.
"No! If you go, I go! I won't go home until I get Mum's necklace back!
"Oh, come on, take him along! He's safer with us, isn't he?
"Hmm... Very well. You take responsibility for protecting Son.
"Thanks, feather brothers! Avarith went into a cave on the cape ahead.
"Alright! Off to beat up the naughty monster!"
